storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Western Story
storyTemplate.description: A western start: ride into a frontier town and handle the first trouble before it becomes a shootout.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Dust rolls down Mercy Flats' main street ahead of your horse.

The saloon doors hang open, the barber has pulled his sign inside, and two men stand in the road pretending their hands are nowhere near their guns.

You have just arrived, and the town is already holding its breath.
